title: [MCP] Server Features in MCP configuration: API Tools, Dynamic Tool Mode, Data Query Tools (Preview)
summary: Adds a Server Features surface to MCP configuration allowing admins to enable Data Query Tools, Dynamic Tool Mode, and API Tools through interface-based, extensible handlers. Each feature controls its own activation, settings, and system tools without requiring page modifications.
key_points: New interface-based feature system where enum values bind to handler codeunits for activation, settings, and system tool loading
Dynamic Tool Mode now requires API Tools to be enabled first and is displayed indented as a sub-feature
Available APIs list allows curated selection of both API pages and queries through a unified lookup
System Tools list-part dynamically populates by iterating active features and calling their handlers
Configuration list gains Set as Default / Clear Default actions and shows read-only API Tools / Data Query Tools status columns
quote: Adds a Server Features surface to the MCP configuration card so admins can opt configurations into the Data Query Tools (Preview) MCP runtime
